# BrickVault (vendored)

Source: https://github.com/connorh315/BrickVault - by **connorh315** (Connor).
Vendored on 2026-09-21 from commit ba85f5c, unmodified except for the removal of
`Decompressors/RNCbackup.cs` (a dead duplicate).

The repository carries no licence file. It is used here with the author's
personal permission, given in the LEGO Dimensions Discord on 2026-09-13, on
the condition that he is credited wherever the code ships. Keep this notice,
and keep his name in the README and the release notes.

What we use it for: `DATFile.BuildFromFolder` (the version-11 archive writer -
the format of PATCH*.DAT and the DLC packages) behind `modcli build`, and its
decompressors.
